description: This PHP class 'AstRuntime' is designed to interpret an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) for JMESPath expressions, using an external tree visitor to perform the interpretation and caching parsed expressions for efficiency.

classes.name: AstRuntime
classes.description: Class for interpreting JMESPath ASTs, with caching and dynamic data evaluation capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser, interpreter, and optional function dispatcher.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the JMESPath expression against provided data, utilizing a cache for parsed expressions.
